events.verdict: Mitchell (CLE) initiates contact to Morant's (MEM) arm, which affects his driving shot attempt.
Morant (MEM) briefly has his arms around Allen (CLE) during the rebound but the contact is marginal.
Aldama (MEM) places his left arm against Mitchell's (CLE) body and the contact during the dunk is marginal.
Jackson Jr. (MEM) gathers the ball on his right foot and takes two steps before the shot attempt.
Allen (CLE) absorbs the body contact initiated by Jackson Jr. (MEM) during the driving shot attempt.
Mitchell (CLE) has his hands placed against Bane (MEM) before releasing to receive the throw-in.
Morant (MEM) legally contests Mitchell's (CLE) jump shot, making "high-five" contact after the ball is released.
Allen (CLE) initiates more than marginal contact with Jackson Jr.'s (MEM) arm, which affects his driving shot attempt.
Memphis is correctly assessed a delay-of-game violation.
Morant (MEM) lowers his arm and initiates contact with Mitchell's (CLE) head, which affects his driving shot attempt.
Jackson Jr. (MEM) clamps and holds Strus's (CLE) arm as he passes and an offensive foul on Jackson Jr. was warranted rather than the foul on Strus.
Aldama (MEM) reaches in and initiates contact to Strus's (CLE) arm, which affects his control of the ball.
Hunter (CLE) moves laterally into Morant's (MEM) path and initiates contact to his body, which affects Morant's driving shot attempt.
Morant (MEM) does not establish a legal guarding position in Mitchell's (CLE) path when he initiates contact to his body, which affects Mitchell's SQBR.
Jackson Jr. (MEM) illegally extends into Mobley's (CLE) path and continues to move backwards, affecting Mobley's ability to contest the impending jump shot.
Okoro (CLE) and Bane (MEM) briefly engage and disengage during the rebound.
Kennard (MEM) makes clean contact to the ball prior to making incidental contact with Okoro's body as both players come together to get to the incoming pass.
Okoro (CLE) avoids making contact to the ball as he steps out of bounds prior to the expiration of the game clock.
